title: PPE Detection System
tagline: Flags a missing helmet before it becomes an incident.

meta.title: PPE Detection System | Foxtroit AI
meta.description: Flags a missing helmet before it becomes an incident.

blocks.title: The Problem
blocks.content: Manually checking that every worker is wearing required protective equipment doesn't scale on a large site, and gaps in compliance often go unnoticed until an incident happens.

blocks.title: The Solution
blocks.content: A YOLO-based detection model monitors camera feeds continuously and triggers an alert the instant it spots a compliance gap.

blocks.title: Outcome
blocks.content: Fewer preventable incidents, and inspection time freed up for other safety work.
